statement: At the original F19 base configuration, compatible based point-pushing sections identify the actual full joint kernel D+ with R1 semidirect R+, where R+=ker(Fhat7->Fhat3) and R1=ker(Fhat8->Fhat4). The complete retained Artin action and its actual geometric basis maps are given. The two kernels are identified by inverse homomorphisms with free profinite groups on the compact generator spaces Fhat3 times four labels and Fhat4 times four labels; continuity of the indexing-group action is proved. The two actual one-point forgettings give an onto map D+->R+ times R-, whose kernel W is the closed normal closure in the actual eight-generator fiber of the stated compact family of cross commutators. The literal commutator [U1,t] in W generates a full closed Zhat. The continuous source map from the free profinite group on L times the sixteen collision labels has image exactly K+, with coordinates supplied by the explicit inverse semidirect maps. The joint image of K+ under the two one-point forgettings is exactly the product of its two marginal images, and the resulting exact source row has kernel K+ intersect W. Each marginal is the image of its actual rank-nineteen, eight-collision source filling kernel. Fullness of either marginal and surjectivity of the named full source map remain unresolved.
depends_on: F17 actual source free meridians and collision maps; F19 actual two-point configuration kernels, full Birman topology, precise source section and exact K+ kernel; F20 Artin conventions and point-pushing inverse coordinate; elementary compact-generator universal-property constructions and exact inverse maps proved in F22
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part F(b), the original residual A5-centralizer and the exact source-membership problem.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The compatible sections use a disk containing all seven old points and the positive point while excluding the negative basepoint, and the comparisons to F19 use constant based paths. The source section j and the point-pushing section sigma remain their actual maps; the coordinate formula uses both without identifying them. The original source free meridians and collision whiskers are retained.
computational_checks: code/part_a/joint_kernel_presentation_f22.py and adjacent JSON/stdout pass 926 exact checks: all seven point-pushing Artin substitutions and inverses; their pure conjugators, boundary product and both filling squares; the actual point-pushing triangular involution in ranks 8,7,4 with its filling maps; the retained deleted-label conjugators; and the interaction commutator in 30 finite Heisenberg groups. The all-moduli power formula and compact/full group conclusions are proved in the text. The producer reads no discovery data.
notes: The free profinite group on a profinite generator space is constructed using precisely the finite quotients whose generator maps are continuous. The indexing-group action is proved jointly continuous by invariant open quotient kernels. The explicit maps to and from the compact-generator semidirect product prove each kernel identification; no completion of an infinitely generated discrete kernel is substituted. W is the exact intersection of two actual fiber filling kernels and is described by inverse maps from the quotient free profinite product to its direct product. The source map has image K+ by the exact F17-F19 free basis and source filling. Its equality with the entire presented D+ remains the original unresolved membership step. No new bibliography key is required. The added joint-image proof uses the full forgetting maps on G when conjugating by j(l), since j(l) need not lie in J. The positive collision meridians are killed by forgetting the positive point and the negative collision meridians by forgetting the negative point; the two compact signed source images therefore independently lift every pair of marginal values.
